thread.title: Exclusive - Sen. Bernie Moreno Introduces Bill to Ban Foreign Flags on Capitol Grounds
thread.title_full: Exclusive - Sen. Bernie Moreno Introduces Bill to Ban Foreign Flags on Capitol Grounds

author: ArbyJay
text:
Ukrainian Flags in Congress – During Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s addresses to Congress, lawmakers, including Republicans, waved Ukrainian flags inside the Capitol chamber and displayed them on the floor in solidarity against Russia. Some also wore Ukrainian flag pins and draped flags over their seats.
Israeli Flags at Pro-Israel Events – GOP lawmakers have held up Israeli flags at press conferences and events on Capitol Hill supporting U.S. aid to Israel. After Hamas’s October 7 attack, some Republican members displayed Israeli flags in their offices and brought them to congressional events.
Cuban and Venezuelan Opposition Flags – At events on Capitol grounds, including Republican-led gatherings criticizing socialist regimes in Cuba and Venezuela, politicians have stood alongside and sometimes held Cuban and Venezuelan opposition flags in solidarity with exiled communities.
Irish Flags on St. Patrick’s Day – The annual Friends of Ireland caucus, attended by Republican lawmakers, has featured Irish flags displayed at official Capitol events recognizing U.S.-Ireland relations.
If Moreno’s bill were applied consistently, it would have banned those too—but we both know that’s not the point. This isn’t about location; it’s about targeting symbols they disapprove of. If free speech suddenly stops at the Capitol doors, then let’s hear the GOP argue why their own displays were acceptable. Otherwise, this is just another performative stunt designed to rile up outrage over nothing. Republicans aren't immune to just because they espouse the same ideology as you. Democrats and Republicans are imperfect and we need to speak out against all politicians when they run afoul. The Bill is to rile up ideological support, not to help or support the American people. It's a charade.
